begin_rx.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) puts the radio into RX mode and switches `gdo0_pin` to input mode.

begin_tx.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) puts the radio into TX mode and switches `gdo0_pin` to output mode.

reset.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) resets the CC1101 chip and re-applies configuration.

data.docs:
**list**: The packet to send, length should match the configured `packet_length`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

send_packet.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) transmits a packet. Only available when `packet_mode` is enabled.

value.docs:
**int**: The channel number. Range: `0` to `255`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_channel.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the channel number at runtime.

value.docs:
**frequency**: The spacing between channels. Range: `25kHz` to `405kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_channel_spacing.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the channel spacing at runtime.

value.docs:
**boolean**: `true` to enable, `false` to disable.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_dc_blocking_filter.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) enables or disables the DC blocking filter at runtime.

value.docs:
**frequency**: The filter bandwidth. Range: `58kHz` to `812kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_filter_bandwidth.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the receive filter bandwidth at runtime.

value.docs:
**frequency**: The frequency to set. Range: `300MHz` to `928MHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_frequency.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the operating frequency at runtime.

value.docs:
**frequency**: The frequency deviation. Range: `1.5kHz` to `381kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_fsk_deviation.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the FSK/GFSK frequency deviation at runtime.

set_idle.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) puts the radio into an idle state.

value.docs:
**frequency**: The intermediate frequency. Range: `25kHz` to `788kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_if_frequency.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the intermediate frequency at runtime.

value.docs:
**boolean**: `true` to enable, `false` to disable.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_manchester.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) enables or disables Manchester encoding at runtime.

value.docs:
**enum**: The modulation type. Options: `ASK/OOK`, `2-FSK`, `4-FSK`, `GFSK`, `MSK`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_modulation_type.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the modulation type at runtime.

value.docs:
**int**: The deviation index. Range: `1` to `8`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_msk_deviation.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the MSK deviation index at runtime.

value.docs:
**float**: The output power in dBm. Range: `-30` to `11`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_output_power.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the transmission power at runtime.

value.docs:
**enum**: The attenuation level. Options: `0dB`, `6dB`, `12dB`, `18dB`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_rx_attenuation.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the internal RX attenuation at runtime.

value.docs:
**float**: The symbol rate in baud. Range: `600` to `500000`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

set_symbol_rate.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) changes the symbol rate at runtime.

bs_limit.docs:
**enum**: Saturation point for data rate offset compensation. Options: `Disabled`, `3.125%`, `6.25%`, `12.5%`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

bs_post_ki.docs:
**enum**: Clock recovery integral gain after sync word detection. Options: `Same`, `KI/2`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

bs_post_kp.docs:
**enum**: Clock recovery proportional gain after sync word detection. Options: `Same`, `KP`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

bs_pre_ki.docs:
**enum**: Clock recovery integral gain before sync word detection. Options: `KI`, `2KI`, `3KI`, `4KI`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

bs_pre_kp.docs:
**enum**: Clock recovery proportional gain before sync word detection. Options: `KP`, `2KP`, `3KP`, `4KP`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

carrier_sense_above_threshold.docs:
**boolean**: Only accept packets when carrier sense indicates a signal is present. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

carrier_sense_abs_thr.docs:
**int**: Absolute RSSI threshold for carrier sense. The radio considers a carrier present when RSSI exceeds this level. Range: `-8` to `7`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

carrier_sense_rel_thr.docs:
**enum**: Relative RSSI threshold for carrier sense, compared to the current noise floor. Options: `Default`, `+6dB`, `+10dB`, `+14dB`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

channel.docs:
**int**: Channel number (added to base frequency). Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

channel_spacing.docs:
**frequency**: Spacing between channels. Range: `25kHz` to `405kHz`. Defaults to `200kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

crc_enable.docs:
**boolean**: Enable CRC-16 calculation and checking. The CC1101 uses CRC-16-IBM (polynomial 0x8005). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types/#pin)**: The SPI Chip Select (CSN) pin connected to the module.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

dc_blocking_filter.docs:
**boolean**: Enable the digital DC blocking filter. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

filter_bandwidth.docs:
**frequency**: The receive filter bandwidth. Range: `58kHz` to `812kHz`. Defaults to `203kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

filter_length_ask_ook.docs:
**enum**: Averaging length for AGC in ASK/OOK modes. Longer values provide more stable gain but slower response. Options: `4dB`, `8dB`, `12dB`, `16dB`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

filter_length_fsk_msk.docs:
**enum**: Averaging length for AGC in FSK/MSK modes. Longer values provide more stable gain but slower response. Options: `8`, `16`, `32`, `64`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

foc_bs_cs_gate.docs:
**boolean**: Freeze frequency offset compensation and clock recovery until carrier sense is asserted.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

foc_limit.docs:
**enum**: Saturation point for frequency offset compensation. Options: `Disabled`, `BW/8`, `BW/4`, `BW/2`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

foc_post_k.docs:
**enum**: Frequency compensation loop gain after sync word detection. Options: `Same`, `K/2`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

foc_pre_k.docs:
**enum**: Frequency compensation loop gain before sync word detection. Options: `K`, `2K`, `3K`, `4K`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

freeze.docs:
**enum**: Controls when AGC gain is frozen (held constant). Options: `Default`, `On Sync`, `Analog Only`, `Analog And Digital`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

frequency.docs:
**frequency**: The operating frequency. Range: `300MHz` to `928MHz`. Defaults to `433.92MHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

fsk_deviation.docs:
**frequency**: Frequency deviation for FSK/GFSK modulation. Range: `1.5kHz` to `381kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

gdo0_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types/#pin)**: The GDO0 pin. Required when `packet_mode` is enabled, also used for single pin mode switching.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

hyst_level.docs:
**enum**: Hysteresis level to prevent gain oscillation on borderline signals. Options: `None`, `Low`, `Medium`, `High`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

if_frequency.docs:
**frequency**: Intermediate Frequency. Range: `25kHz` to `788kHz`. Defaults to `153kHz`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

lna_priority.docs:
**boolean**: If true, reduce LNA gain before DVGA gain when decreasing overall gain. Useful for optimizing noise figure. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

magn_target.docs:
**dB**: Target signal amplitude for the AGC loop. Higher values increase sensitivity but may cause clipping on strong signals. Range: `24dB` to `42dB` in increments of 3 (e.g., `33dB`). Defaults to `42dB`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

manchester.docs:
**boolean**: Enable Manchester encoding. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

max_dvga_gain.docs:
**enum**: Limits the maximum DVGA (Digital Variable Gain Amplifier) gain. Options: `Default`, `-1`, `-2`, `-3`. Defaults to `-3`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

max_lna_gain.docs:
**dB**: Limits the maximum LNA (Low Noise Amplifier) gain. Use to prevent saturation in high-signal environments. Defaults to `Default`. Options: `Default`, `2.6dB`, `6.1dB`, `7.4dB`, `9.2dB`, `11.5dB`, `14.6dB`, `17.1dB`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

modulation_type.docs:
**enum**: The modulation format. Options: `ASK/OOK` (default), `2-FSK`, `4-FSK`, `GFSK`, `MSK`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

msk_deviation.docs:
**int**: Deviation index for MSK modulation. Range: `1` to `8`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

num_preamble.docs:
**int**: Number of preamble bytes to transmit. Range: `0` to `7` (maps to 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24 bytes). Defaults to `2` (4 bytes).

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

output_power.docs:
**float**: The transmission power in dBm. Range: `-30` to `11`. Defaults to `10`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

packet_length.docs:
**int**: Packet length in bytes. Set to `0` for variable length packets (length byte prepended to data). Range: `0` to `64`. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

packet_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Enable FIFO packet mode. When enabled, `gdo0_pin` is required. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

rx_attenuation.docs:
**enum**: Internal RX attenuation. Options: `0dB`, `6dB`, `12dB`, `18dB`. Defaults to `0dB`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

symbol_rate.docs:
**int**: The symbol rate in Baud. Range: `600` to `500000`. Defaults to `5000`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

sync0.docs:
**hex**: Lower sync word byte. Defaults to `0x91`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

sync1.docs:
**hex**: Upper sync word byte. Defaults to `0xD3`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

sync_mode.docs:
**enum**: Sync word detection mode. Options: `None`, `15/16`, `16/16`, `30/32`. Defaults to `16/16`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

wait_time.docs:
**enum**: Time to wait after a gain change before allowing another adjustment. Options: `8`, `16`, `24`, `32`. Defaults to `32`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*

whitening.docs:
**boolean**: Enable data whitening to improve DC balance. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver](https://esphome.io/components/cc1101#configuration-variables)*
